regions.label: INesHeader
regions.evidence: Validated iNES header declares mapper 1, eight 16-KiB PRG units and sixteen 8-KiB CHR units; immutable inspection and baseline.

regions.label: ChrTilePatterns
regions.evidence: iNES CHR-ROM section: PPU pattern backing, 16-byte two-plane NES tile records. Inspected tile-pattern bytes and rendered copyright/narrative/screens; CPU analysis rejects CHR as code. Exact section bounds from header.
